long_description:
# Nidra and Sound Bath

Yoga Nidra can be defined as 'yogic sleep'. It is a state of restful awareness as we are guided through the layers of the body accessing a deep sense of relaxation. It has been said that one hour of Yoga Nidra is equivelant 3 or more hours of deep sleep.

We will follow this guided relaxation with a sound bath of Crystal Singing Bowls, Chimes, and Gong. Take 90 minutes for yourself to rest deeply and see what shifts.\

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Austin.
